title: Ruleset: partner_moves
description: rules/<id>/partner_moves.yaml: the moves the partner equips when it starts and when it is reborn (apps/session: PartnerMoveRules, apps/session/README.md). A position is an index in the species' move list (data/digimon: moves).

new_game_slot.description: The position of the first technique of the new game's partner, which it also learns.

reborn_slot.description: The position of the only move a reborn partner equips; it keeps the learned ones.
